cards.answer: Braum is a tank support who protects allies by intercepting enemy projectiles. He helps allies stun enemies through shared passive stacks. His broad learning focus is health, armor and magic resistance.
cards.counterplay: INFERRED: Avoid building passive stacks, and look for attack angles around his shield.

cards.answer: Braum's basic attacks and Q apply passive stacks; allied champion basic attacks can add stacks after the first. At 4 stacks, the target takes magic damage and is stunned. Afterward, the target temporarily cannot gain new stacks, but Braum's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to it.
cards.counterplay: INFERRED: Back away from Braum and his allies when marked to avoid letting their basic attacks complete the stun.

cards.answer: Braum raises a directional shield that intercepts enemy projectiles, making them hit him and be destroyed. From that direction, it negates the first instance of champion damage and reduces further damage he takes. Intercepted projectiles can still apply their on-hit effects.
cards.counterplay: INFERRED: Reposition to attack from outside the shield's protected direction. Avoid spending a key projectile into its interception.

citations.quote: Active: Braum becomes ghosted and raises his shield in a direction for a few seconds, intercepting any enemy projectiles to hit him and be destroyed.
Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed.

facts.claim: Braum raises a directional shield that intercepts enemy projectiles, making them hit him and be destroyed.

citations.quote: intercepts all incoming hostile projectiles and reduces the damage Braum takes through it from enemies in the target direction. The first instance of damage dealt by a champion from this direction is reduced by 100%.

facts.claim: From that direction, it negates the first instance of champion damage and reduces further damage he takes.

citations.quote: Projectiles whose effects trigger on collision will still trigger - dealing damage, applying debuffs, creating area of effects and marking the target as 'hit'.

facts.claim: Intercepted projectiles can still apply their on-hit effects.

cards.priority_reason: Projectile interception can deny attacks aimed at allies, making shield direction consequential.
uncertainties: Interception does not mean all projectile effects are canceled; collision effects can still occur.

cards.answer: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line ahead. The fissure left along that line slows enemies.
cards.counterplay: INFERRED: Move out of the line ahead of Braum and avoid the lingering fissure.

facts.claim: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line ahead.

citations.quote: A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.

facts.claim: The fissure left along that line slows enemies.

cards.priority_reason: The knockup can interrupt enemy pressure, while the fissure controls movement.
